ORDER (Order of the Court was made by DR.ANITA SUMANTH, J.)
Read this order in continuance and in conjunction with order dated 24.09.2025, that reads as follows.
"Mr.Sivabalan, learned Standing Counsel for Madurai Corporation files a one page report, which contains absolutely no particulars in regard to the allegations in the writ affidavit.
2.Under our order dated 23.09.2025, we had specifically asked that an official from the Tamil Nadu Fire and Rescue Service Department to accompany the team to inspect the premises.

Report by then."
2.
Today, detailed Status Report has been filed along with a compilation of the approvals that have been granted for the conduct of the exhibition.
These approvals contain various conditions.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

As per the Status Report filed by R4, i.e., the Deputy Director, Tamil Nadu Fire and Rescue Service Department, No Objection Certificate (NOS) issued by the Fire and Rescue Service Department contains 15 conditions, of which, 10 have not been complied with.

sentences.text:
4. At Paragraph 4 of the counter affidavit filed, they state as follows:-
"4.

I respectfully submit that, as per the direction of this Hon'ble Court a team of officials comprising the Respondents 2, 3 and 4 conducted joint inspection on 24.09.2025 and it was found that though stated in the No Objection Certificate the following directions were not carried out:
i) The Guna Cave exibit is an artificial cave of 450 m length with nature resembling curves, the external and internal walls and roof top should be spray with Fire Retardant Solution.
ii) Emergency exit should be provided every 50 meters, the emergency exit should be designed to open outwards, and should be marked with reflector paint to look prominent.
iii) Each emergency exit must be at least 2.5 meters wide and should be 3 meters wide in great halls.
iv) Emergency exit signage and emergency exit plan should be clearly visible to the public and should be set up as per IS 12349 (safety signs for use in the field of fire protection and firefighting)& IS 12407 (Graphic symbols for fire protection plans).
v) A 10,000 liter water tank should be installed https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

(
Uploaded on: 03/10/2025 12:48:39 pm ) specifically for firefighting. A 900 LPM capacity fire pump and hose reel should be installed.
vi) Emergency Lights 10 No's (Battery Backup) should be available in case of power cut in the cave.

3 vii) Straws spread on the floor in the room of the birds exhibit should be removed.

sentences.text: viii) There are only 5 fire extinguishers in the exhibition and additionally, 10Kg ABC fire extinguishers 10 No's should be kept.

ix) To hold a home appliance exhibition with a Giant Wheel, entrances should be 5 meters wide on all four sides to allow easy thoroughfare for fire trucks, and the decorative arches and electric wires at the entrances should be at least 5 meters above the ground.

x) A public information center should be set up to for emergency announcements to the public over loudspeakers"
5.

We are of the view that until such time, the conditions are all complied, the question of continuing the Exhibition and Amusement Park does not arise.
6.

If at all, R5 wishes to continue with the Exhibition / Guna Cave Exhibition, let all the conditions be scrupulously complied and only after a proper inspection by the Authorities, who will certify that the conditions have been complied, shall the Exhibition resume.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
7. This Writ Petition stands allowed in light of this order.
No costs.
Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
